poses.desc: kicking a football HARD toward the LEFT SIDE OF THE FRAME and getting it completely wrong: he faces LEFT in profile, the leg nearest the viewer is swung high and through, the body leaning back off balance, eyes screwed shut and face straining. NO ball is drawn, he kicks THIN AIR

striking a football cleanly toward the RIGHT SIDE OF THE FRAME: he faces RIGHT in profile, the leg nearest the viewer swung through with the foot pointed, body balanced and leaning into the shot, eyes open and focused, confident. NO ball is drawn, he kicks THIN AIR

ONE character split straight down the middle, front view, standing still. His LEFT half (the viewer's left) wears the PLAIN YELLOW national-team shirt with a green collar and blue shorts, that half of his face is miserable and defeated with the eye downcast and the shoulder slumped. His RIGHT half (the viewer's right) wears the CLARET-AND-BLUE striped club shirt with the gold star and dark shorts, that half of his face is beaming with a wide happy grin and the shoulder up. The split is a clean vertical line exactly down the centre of his body, face included. Same short curly black hair on both halves

cenarios.desc: a bleak empty football pitch on a grey rainy afternoon: dull washed-out grass, a puddle or two, the goal off to the left side, and behind it a COMPLETELY EMPTY concrete stand with rows of bare seats and nobody in them, under a heavy grey overcast sky. Muted desaturated grey-green palette, cold and joyless. COMPOSITION: sky and the empty stand across the UPPER 45 percent, and the open GRASS filling everything BELOW that, clear from side to side. The horizon and the grass line must sit EXACTLY at 45 percent down the frame

a joyful football pitch on a bright sunny afternoon: vivid green grass with mown stripes, the goal off to the right side, and behind it a stand PACKED with a cheering crowd in deep red and navy, colourful banners and flags along the rail, warm golden sunlight and a clear blue sky. Warm saturated festive palette. COMPOSITION: sky and the packed stand across the UPPER 45 percent, and the open GRASS filling everything BELOW that, clear from side to side. The horizon and the grass line must sit EXACTLY at 45 percent down the frame
